title: Amazon.com to Open Fulfillment Center in Joliet
summary: Amazon.com announced plans to open its first fulfillment center in Illinois, located in Joliet. This nearly 500,000-square-foot facility is expected to create 1,000 full-time jobs with competitive wages and comprehensive benefits. Local officials, including Joliet Mayor Bob O’Dekirk, expressed enthusiasm for Amazon's investment and its positive impact on the community and job market.

title: Kroger top among supermarkets in customer service
summary: Kroger Co. was recognized for its excellent customer service, earning first place among supermarkets and fifth place overall in 24/7 Wall St.’s annual 2015 Customer Service Hall of Fame. This achievement was based on a survey of over 1,500 adults, where more than 77 percent reported a good or excellent experience with Kroger. Jayne Homco, president of The Kroger Co. of Michigan, highlighted the company's commitment to investing in its employees and providing world-class service.

title: QVC owner to acquire Zulily for $2.4 billion
summary: Liberty Interactive, owner of the shopping channel QVC, announced plans to acquire online retailer Zulily for $2.4 billion. The deal involves purchasing all outstanding Zulily (ZU) shares at $18.75 each and is expected to close in Q4 2015. This acquisition aims to leverage QVC's scale and customer base to boost Zulily's growth, especially as Zulily has faced recent challenges in customer acquisition.

title: QVC adding smartphone shoppers with Zulily purchase
summary: QVC, owned by Liberty Interactive Corp., has announced its acquisition of Zulily Inc. for $2.4 billion in cash and stock. This strategic move aims to broaden QVC's customer base by attracting Zulily's younger, smartphone-savvy mothers, complementing QVC's existing demographic of 35- to 65-year-old women. Despite a disappointing return for Zulily investors, the companies plan to operate largely independently while leveraging each other's vendor and customer lists to boost sales and market presence.

title: Rackspace Is the Leader in the Hosted Private Cloud Market
summary: Rackspace leads the hosted private cloud market with a 20% market share, despite it being a highly fragmented market. While Amazon Web Services is the current leader in IaaS, Rackspace, Microsoft Azure, and VMware's vCloud Air are emerging as competitive challengers. A potential alliance between these three could significantly challenge Amazon's market dominance.

title: The rise of copyright infringement lawsuits—and what retailers can do about it
summary: A new report by Lex Machina indicates a significant rise in copyright infringement lawsuits targeting retailers over textile patterns, with major players like Ross Stores and TJX frequently named defendants. These cases often involve substantial settlement costs, prompting retailers to develop proactive strategies and seek experienced legal counsel to minimize financial exposure. The article advises retailers to understand the costs of litigation versus settlement and to be cautious about specific plaintiffs known for frequent filings.

title: Sharing insights elevates their impact
summary: Momentum investing has proven to be a winning strategy in the current market, with US momentum ETFs seeing their assets under management more than double. The iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor has significantly outperformed the S&P 500, while shares with poor momentum, particularly in the oil and gas sector, have underperformed dramatically. This trend has also led to lower short interest in high-momentum stocks.
